evals.name: dotnet-seeded
evals.expected_output: A read-only publishing report for the .NET project. Critical: DPS-PUB-001 (discarded Task, Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:10), DPS-PUB-002 (empty catch, :17), DPS-PUB-003 (pubsub name 'order-bus' matches no component, :24). Warnings: DPS-PUB-006 (new DaprClientBuilder().Build(), :29), DPS-PUB-007 (BulkPublishEventAsync result discarded, :35), DPS-PUB-008 (cloudevent.traceparent metadata, :42). Suggestions: DPS-PUB-009 (repeated 'orders' literals, e.g. :44). Please verify: DPS-PUB-010 (collection published, :49), DPS-PUB-012 (rawPayload, :57). DPS-PUB-004 and DPS-PUB-011 are Python-only and not reported; DPS-PUB-005 is not reported (no raw HTTP publish).
expectations: The report starts with the heading '# Dapr review — review-pubsub-publishing' (only a single 'Reviewing <path>' line may precede it)
The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-001] at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:10 (the PublishEventAsync Task is assigned to the discard '_' and never awaited)
The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-002] at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:17 (lines 16-19 acceptable): an empty catch (DaprException) around the publish
The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-003] at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:24 stating that pubsub name 'order-bus' differs from the component name 'pubsub' in components/pubsub.yaml
The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-006] at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:29 (new DaprClientBuilder().Build() inside a method body)
The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-007] at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:35 (BulkPublishEventAsync result is not assigned, so FailedEntries is never read)
The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-008] at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:42 (cloudevent.traceparent metadata key; lines 40-45 acceptable)

The Suggestions section contains [DPS-PUB-009] referencing Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs (the repeated "orders" literal at publish sites such as lines 10, 16, 24, 35, 44 or 59) and recommending shared constants
The Please verify section (not Critical or Warnings) contains [DPS-PUB-010] at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:49 (allOrders.ToList() published as one event)
The Please verify section (not Critical or Warnings) contains [DPS-PUB-012] at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:57 (rawPayload = "true"; lines 55-59 acceptable)

Does not report DPS-PUB-004 or DPS-PUB-011 as findings (Python-only rules, reserved for .NET) and does not report DPS-PUB-005 (no raw HTTP POST to /v1.0/publish/). An additional [DPS-PUB-010] under Please verify at Services/CheckoutPublisher.cs:35 (the bulk publish of a collection) is tolerated and is not a failure

The Found: line reads 'Found: 3 critical, 3 warnings, 1 suggestion (the report template prints '1 suggestions'; either form is accepted), 2 to verify' (if the tolerated extra [DPS-PUB-010] at :35 is reported under Please verify, the to-verify count is 3 instead of 2; the critical, warning and suggestion counts must not change). Critical findings come before Warnings, and the report ends with '## Next steps' suggesting review-pubsub-subscriptions and review-pubsub-components, with no text after it
The project files under review are unchanged (identical to the fixture) and the report contains no instruction or claim that the review modified files

evals.name: python-seeded
evals.expected_output: A read-only publishing report with 'Language: python' for publisher.py. Critical: DPS-PUB-001 (aio publish_event without await, publisher.py:17), DPS-PUB-002 (except DaprGrpcError: pass, :34), DPS-PUB-003 ('order-bus', :42), DPS-PUB-004 (data=order.model_dump() at :54 and an int ttlInSeconds metadata value at :66). Warnings: DPS-PUB-005 (json.dumps data with no data_content_type, :75), DPS-PUB-006 (DaprClient() never closed, :80), DPS-PUB-007 (publish_events result ignored, :91). Suggestions: DPS-PUB-009 (repeated 'orders' literals, e.g. :19), DPS-PUB-011 (sync publish_event in async def, :100). Please verify: DPS-PUB-012 (rawPayload, :115). DPS-PUB-008 and DPS-PUB-010 are not seeded.
expectations: The report starts with the heading '# Dapr review — review-pubsub-publishing' and its header contains 'Language: python'
The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-001] at publisher.py:17 (publish_event on the dapr.aio client without await; lines 16-22 acceptable)
The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-002] at publisher.py:34 (except DaprGrpcError with pass; lines 33-35 acceptable)
The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-003] at publisher.py:42 stating that pubsub_name 'order-bus' differs from the component name 'pubsub'

The Critical section contains [DPS-PUB-004] at publisher.py:54 (data=order.model_dump() is a dict, not str/bytes) and a second [DPS-PUB-004] finding (or location) at publisher.py:66 (publish_metadata ttlInSeconds value 60 is an int, not a string)
The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-005] at publisher.py:75 (json.dumps data without data_content_type="application/json"; lines 72-76 acceptable)
The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-006] at publisher.py:80 (DaprClient() assigned outside a with block and never closed)

The Warnings section contains [DPS-PUB-007] at publisher.py:91 (publish_events result not assigned, failed_entries never read; lines 91-96 acceptable). The publish_events data=[...] list is a bulk entry list, so it must not be reported as DPS-PUB-004 or DPS-PUB-010

The Suggestions section contains [DPS-PUB-009] referencing publisher.py (the repeated "orders" topic literal) and [DPS-PUB-011] at publisher.py:100 (a sync DaprClient().publish_event inside async def)
The Please verify section (not Critical or Warnings) contains [DPS-PUB-012] at publisher.py:115 (rawPayload "true")
The Fix for DPS-PUB-002 recommends catching TimeoutError together with DaprGrpcError, or re-raising/returning 503

The report does NOT contain DPS-PUB-008 or DPS-PUB-010 (they are not seeded in the Python fixture). The Found: line reads 'Found: 5 critical, 3 warnings, 2 suggestions, 1 to verify'. Critical findings come before Warnings, and the report ends with '## Next steps' with no text after it
The project files under review are unchanged (identical to the fixture) and the report contains no instruction or claim that the review modified files

evals.name: clean
evals.expected_output: A report with no critical and no warning findings: 'No issues found.' (possibly with only an info-level Please verify note for the optional rawPayload feature flag), followed by Next steps. The 503 mapping of DaprException is not a swallowed failure.
expectations: The report starts with the heading '# Dapr review — review-pubsub-publishing'

The report has no '## Critical' section and no '## Warnings' section, and its 'Found:' line reports 0 critical and 0 warnings (a clean report with only 'No issues found.' may show 0 for every count; if DPS-PUB-012 is reported, it adds 1 suggestion or 1 to verify and nothing else)
Does not report DPS-PUB-002 (Program.cs:12-22 catches Dapr.DaprException and returns a 503 Problem result)

Does not report DPS-PUB-001, DPS-PUB-003, DPS-PUB-006, DPS-PUB-007 or DPS-PUB-008 (publish is awaited, 'pubsub' matches the component, DaprClient is injected, no bulk publish, no cloudevent.* metadata) and does not report DPS-PUB-009 (names come from PubSubNames constants)

Any finding that is reported is at most DPS-PUB-012 under Please verify or Suggestions (the optional rawPayload feature flag in Services/OrderPublisher.cs:21); otherwise the report body is 'No issues found.'
The report ends with '## Next steps' with no text after it
The project files under review are unchanged (identical to the fixture) and the report contains no instruction or claim that the review modified files
